findings.evidenceJa: ありったけの力、吼えだしかねない程の力を込めて
findings.governingReading: Shirou puts every bit of strength he has into the response—enough force that he might almost roar.
findings.explanation: The English replaces extreme physical and vocal exertion with abstract determination, weakening how difficult the assent is for him to force out.

findings.highlight: I didn’t think you’d be okay with taking the Shroud off
findings.evidenceJa: 聖骸布を外してもいい、だなんてあっさり言うとは思わなかっただけで
findings.governingReading: Rin says she did not expect Shirou to state so readily that removing the Shroud was acceptable.
findings.explanation: The English changes Rin’s judgment of how readily he voiced the answer into a claim about his private willingness, obscuring the contrast between his hidden effort and her perception of his delivery.
